summary: An unoptimized slow query in the inventory service caused database connection pool exhaustion, leading to cascading timeouts across orders and gateway.

alerts.name: PodCrashLooping
alerts.summary: orders: container restarted 2.034 times in 10 minutes

hypotheses.summary: A slow database query joining products and stock_movements in the inventory service takes several seconds, exhausting inventory's database connection pool and causing cascading timeouts and errors in orders and gateway.

evidence.quote: 2026-10-07 05:13:59.015 UTC [2457] LOG:  duration: 3333.351 ms  execute S_6: SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.category, p.price_cents, p.stock,
evidence.shows: Inventory's product/stock query taking over 3 seconds.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.sql.SQLTransientConnectionException: inventory-db - Connection is not available, request timed out after 2000ms (total=10, active=10, idle=0, waiting=11)
evidence.shows: Inventory database connection pool exhaustion caused by slow queries holding connections open.
Upstream calls timing out at the gateway due to cascading slowness from inventory and orders.

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Add an appropriate index on stock_movements (sku, reason, created_at) or optimize the stock aggregation query in the inventory service to prevent table/sequential scans from saturating database connections.
